title: Quotas and Usage Plans
learning_outcomes: Explain how quotas and usage plans affects an API contract or implementation.

content.intro: This lesson focuses on quotas and usage plans in rate limiting, reliability, and resilience. You will connect daily and monthly quotas to a concrete API contract decision, inspect a small example, and decide what evidence proves the behavior is correct.
content.why_it_matters: Quotas and Usage Plans matters because API consumers depend on predictable behavior even when clients, servers, networks, and stored data evolve independently. Applying daily and monthly quotas deliberately reduces ambiguity, makes failures easier to diagnose, and gives tests a clear expectation.

content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: Rate limits and resilience policies protect capacity; retries should be bounded, observable, and safe for the operation. In this lesson, treat “Quotas and Usage Plans” as a design or implementation decision: name the expected behavior, identify its boundary, and verify it with a representative request or test.
